title: TRIA dataset metadata schema, shared attributes
description: Schema for one row of main dataset-related data, shared by submission files and TRIA dataset files

ds_title.description: Descriptive title for the dataset, for use in citations (similar to a paper title).

ds_license.description: License of the dataset, as in the TRIA license lookup table. "other": placeholder in submission files for a license to be agreed with TRIA. "All rights reserved": TRIA dataset files of embargoed datasets.
